lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cincinnati Bengals −13.0 with a fair total of 46.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Tennessee Titans pass defence, which sits +0.274 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
